message:
I hope you are doing well.

We are looking for an electrical contractor to provide an EPC quote for an EV charging project. Please review the high-level scope of work below and let us know if you can share an estimate and availability.

Scope of Work:

City permitting

Installation of 600A, 3-phase switchboard

Installation of conduits

Wire runs

Installation of EV chargers

Installation of wheel stops

Inspections

System testing and quality checks to ensure proper functionality and safety

Please let us know what information you would need from our side to prepare the estimate.

Thank you, and I look forward to your response.

Best regards,
Anant
